text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following clear instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses neural networks to handle complex tasks, like recognising images or speech. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it in search engines, voice assistants, social media, and even in medical diagnosis. AI is changing the way we live and work.
